changelog: The bundled creativebranding/sms is v1.1.0. Settings::smsMissing() is now the package's Account::missing(), with CTRACKING_SMS_TOKEN in the secret's place, so the readiness rule lives in one place for every Creative plugin. No change in behaviour.
phpcs.xml: the vendor/ exclude is case-sensitive and anchored to a folder, and src/Vendor/ (the package's copy, linted in its own repository) is excluded on purpose, with a comment saying why.
